campaign.description: utm_campaign: campaign, product or promotion name.

content.description: utm_content: which link or creative, e.g. header_button.

id.description: utm_id: campaign ID used for GA4 data import.

lowercase.description: Lowercase every value (default true; GA4 values are case sensitive).

medium.description: utm_medium: marketing medium, e.g. email, social, cpc, referral, affiliate.

source.description: utm_source: who sends the traffic, e.g. newsletter, linkedin, google.

spaces.description: How to write spaces inside values: dash (default), underscore, plus (+) or keep (%20).

url.description: Landing page URL. https:// is added if the scheme is missing.

title: Build a UTM campaign URL
